response.sql: WITH player_totals AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) as total FROM appearances a INNER JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country != '' AND a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.player_id, p.death_country), average_total AS (SELECT AVG(total) as avg_total FROM player_totals), above_average AS (SELECT pt.total, av.avg_total, pt.total - av.avg_total as excess FROM player_totals pt CROSS JOIN average_total av WHERE pt.total > av.avg_total) SELECT SUM(total) as sum_of_totals, AVG(excess) as avg_excess FROM above_average
